specFidelityNotes: Diff 77ba8910..HEAD (#617 CDP-A2-3). PostgresIoBudgetGovernor adds independent per-run I/O caps on bronze flush (try_bronze_flush), silver upsert batch (try_silver_upsert), and concurrent shop slots (try_acquire_shop/release_shop). finish(postgres_io_throttled) sets implies_partition_complete=False with defer_reason; finish(complete) allows partition complete. Env knobs BATCH_BRONZE_ROWS_PER_FLUSH / BATCH_SILVER_UPSERT_BATCH_SIZE / BATCH_MAX_CONCURRENT_SHOPS with positive-value validation. Structured log fields: bronze_flush_size, silver_batch_size, concurrent_shop_count, batch_postgres_io_deferred_total, stopped_reason, defer_reason — no tokens/PII. MODULE.md documents dual-budget requirement and Partner-only insufficiency. Package __init__ exports governor + begin_postgres_io_budget_run. Orthogonal to PartnerApiBudgetGovernor (#616); no A1 webhook/cdp_speed paths touched.

convention_notes.note: Pure in-memory governor mirrors partner_budget.py shape; no cross-module internal reach-through.
